highlights: OpenAI has significantly expanded its enterprise and developer offerings, launching the Agents API, specialized ChatGPT for Financial Services, and revealing new AI-powered advertising models, alongside the powerful GPT-6 Astra for business applications.

The AI agent ecosystem is rapidly maturing with new tools and research focused on real-world deployment challenges, including open-source harnesses for web agents, adaptive frameworks for clinical AI, and advanced techniques for diagnosing agent failures and optimizing token efficiency.

Innovation in foundation models continues with highly efficient, open-source models like ZGCM-1 for math and agentic search, and specialized tabular models like TabPFN-3.5 demonstrating state-of-the-art performance, pushing the boundaries of what compact and domain-specific AI can achieve.

agents.title: Google Releases Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking for Production Grade Voice Agents
agents.summary: Google introduced Gemini 3.8 Live and Extended Thinking models, enabling production-grade voice agents that process live visuals, switch languages, and execute tools dynamically, offering real-time conversational AI.

agents.title: Agent-net Open Sources Webagent: A Go Harness That Turns Any Website into a Guarded AI Agent
agents.summary: Agent-net released Webagent, an open-source Go harness that allows businesses to transform any website into a public-facing, guarded AI agent capable of interacting with other agents. This simplifies agent creation by replacing orchestration code with configuration.

agents.title: Asclepius: An Adaptive Harness for Long-Horizon Clinical Agents
agents.summary: Asclepius is an adaptive agent scaffolding designed to manage long-horizon clinical tasks, using a self-evolving harness and subagents to significantly improve critical-action correctness and timeliness for clinical AI applications.

models.title: GPT-6 Astra: The next generation in intelligence for work
models.summary: OpenAI announced GPT-6 Astra, their most capable business-focused model, featuring advanced reasoning, computer use, and superior writing and design judgment to enhance enterprise applications.

models.title: ZGCM-1: A Fully Open and Extremely Efficient Foundation Model for Math and Agentic Search
models.summary: ZGCM-1 is a fully open, 7B dense foundation model trained for math and agentic search, achieving competitive performance against much larger frontier models with significant efficiency improvements.

models.title: Prior Labs Releases TabPFN-3.5: A Tabular Foundation Model That Beats the Winning Otto Kaggle Solution With Default Settings
models.summary: Prior Labs introduced TabPFN-3.5, a tabular foundation model trained solely on synthetic data, demonstrating superior performance by surpassing the winning Otto Kaggle solution with out-of-the-box settings.

tools.title: Introducing the Agents API
tools.summary: OpenAI unveiled the Agents API, a managed service powered by the Codex harness, enabling developers to build and deploy robust cloud agents with built-in orchestration, long-running sessions, and tool use.

tools.title: NVIDIA Open-Sources OSMO: One YAML Orchestrates Physical AI Training, Simulation, and Robot Testing
tools.summary: NVIDIA open-sourced OSMO, a Kubernetes-native workflow orchestrator, streamlining the definition and execution of physical AI tasks, including training, simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop testing, via a single YAML file.

tools.title: Introducing @huggingface/kernels: 200+ WebGPU Kernels for Local AI
tools.summary: Hugging Face introduced `@huggingface/kernels`, a collection of over 200 WebGPU kernels, empowering developers to run performant AI computations directly within web browsers for local AI applications.

companies.title: Reimagining advertising with AI
companies.summary: OpenAI is exploring new AI-powered advertising experiences, including Sponsored Agents and tools for marketers, signaling a strategic move into AI-driven monetization and market expansion.

companies.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Financial Services
companies.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Financial Services, a specialized offering combining built-in financial data with GPT-6 Astra for enhanced research, modeling, and client material generation tailored for the finance industry.

companies.title: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
companies.summary: Perplexity is leveraging OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra model for critical end-to-end systems, including communications, software changes, and production monitoring, highlighting Astra's reliability and capability for complex operational tasks.

learning.title: Inside NVIDIA’s cuDNN Graph API: Fusion, Autotuning, and Plan Reuse with cuDNN Frontend
learning.summary: This practical tutorial provides deep learning developers with guidance on leveraging NVIDIA’s cuDNN Frontend Graph API to build custom kernel fusions, optimize computations, and validate results against PyTorch.

learning.title: DevFest is back
learning.summary: DevFest 2026 is returning with over 800 global events, offering developers an opportunity to connect, build, secure, and scale solutions in the evolving agentic AI era.

learning.title: Training and Finetuning Multi-Vector Embedding Models with Sentence Transformers
learning.summary: A comprehensive guide on training and fine-tuning multi-vector embedding models using Sentence Transformers, providing practical steps for developers to enhance their natural language processing applications.
